eval: (() => { const A = __app, P = A.world.physics, q = A.pup.pos; let best = null; for (const t of A.world.streamer.ready()) for (const s of t.data.solids) { const h = s.h - A.world.heightAt(s.pts[0][0], s.pts[0][1]); if (h > 1.8 && h < 2.6 && s.pts.length === 4) { const cx = (s.pts[0][0] + s.pts[2][0]) / 2, cz = (s.pts[0][1] + s.pts[2][1]) / 2, d = Math.hypot(cx - q.x, cz - q.z); if (!best || d < best.d) best = { cx, cz, d, s }; } } if (!best) return 'no wall'; const a = best.s.pts[0], b = best.s.pts[1], ux = b[0] - a[0], uz = b[1] - a[1], L = Math.hypot(ux, uz), nx = -uz / L, nz = ux / L; A.pup.placeAt(best.cx + nx * 1.6, best.cz + nz * 1.6, Math.atan2(-nx, -nz), A.world); A.cam.snapBehind(A.pup); window.__wall = best; return 'wall at ' + best.d.toFixed(0) + ' m, top ' + (best.s.h).toFixed(1); })()
